ActionSpec.description: Something an agent can do. Each legal action becomes one typed tool.

by.description: Agent type(s) allowed to take it.
by.title: By

when.description: Requirements; the tool is offered only when all hold.
when.title: When

chance.description: Probability of success; `do` on success, `otherwise` on failure.
chance.title: Chance

otherwise.description: Effects when the chance roll fails.
otherwise.title: Otherwise

outcome.description: What the actor is told (template over $actor, $params).
outcome.title: Outcome

private.description: Nobody else learns this action happened.
private.title: Private

terminal.description: Taking it ends the agent's turn: true, or an expression checked after it applies ($actor, $params).
terminal.title: Terminal

ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

ArmSpec.description: An experiment variant: input overrides and/or a contract patch.

patch.description: Deep-merged into the contract (objects merge, lists replace).
patch.title: Patch

ArmSpec.title: ArmSpec

BlockSpec.description:
A named, reusable effect list: ``{"block": "settle", "with": {"buyer": "$actor"}}``.
The effects see only the arguments (plus $inputs, $world, $round …), never the caller's locals.
BlockSpec.title: BlockSpec

Brief.description: Static text every agent receives once per wake, before anything dynamic (cacheable).

situation.description: What this world is and what is going on (template; {$inputs.x} works).
situation.title: Situation

rules.description: How it works: what agents can do and what happens (template).
rules.title: Rules

roles.description: Extra brief per agent type (template over $actor).
roles.title: Roles

Brief.title: Brief

Clock.description: How long a run lasts and how rounds are labelled.

unit.description: Name of one round: day, week, turn, hour …
unit.title: Unit

start.description: ISO date of round 1 (adds a calendar date).
start.title: Start

step.description: Units per round (e.g. 7 with unit 'day' = weekly rounds).
step.title: Step

Clock.title: Clock

Condition.description: A requirement: ``"$actor.cash > 0"`` or ``{"expr": ..., "why": "You have no money."}``.
Condition.title: Condition

DefSpec.description:
A named, reusable expression called like a built-in: ``$utility($actor, $params.offer)``.
Shorthand: the expression text (no arguments).

args.description: Argument names; the body reads them as roots ($side).
args.title: Args

DefSpec.title: DefSpec

EndSpec.description: A condition that ends the run early.
EndSpec.title: EndSpec

brief.description: Private text added to this entity's own brief (template).
brief.title: Brief

EventSpec.description: World logic outside agent turns: scheduled, periodic, conditional or random.

chance.description: Probability of firing when otherwise due.
chance.title: Chance

each.description: Run `do` once per item ($it): a type or expression.
each.title: Each

as.description: Name for the item instead of $it.
as.title: As

EventSpec.title: EventSpec

GraphSpace.description: Named places joined by edges; positions are place names. Distance is the shortest path.
GraphSpace.title: GraphSpace

GridSpace.description: A rows × cols board; positions are [row, col]. Distance is steps (diagonal: king moves).
GridSpace.title: GridSpace

InputSpec.description: A typed value supplied when the environment is loaded (``fg_env.load(..., inputs=)``).

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, list, table, map, date, any
type.title: Type

default.description: Used when the caller supplies nothing.
default.title: Default

required.description: The caller must supply it (no default).
required.title: Required

InputSpec.title: InputSpec

InvariantSpec.description: Must always hold; checked after every action and round. A violation fails the run.
InvariantSpec.title: InvariantSpec

LinkSpec.description: Starting links: one explicit link, or a generated network among a type.

among.description: Generate links among entities of this type.
among.title: Among

p.description: Link probability (random) or rewiring probability (small_world). For random it may depend on the pair: '0.1 if $to.influencer else 0.02'.
p.title: P

LinkSpec.title: LinkSpec

MetricSpec.description: A number tracked every round (a series). Shorthand: the expression.
MetricSpec.title: MetricSpec

OutputSpec.description: A typed field of the run result. ``$metrics.x`` is a metric's final value, ``$series.x`` its history.

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, list, map, any
type.title: Type

OutputSpec.title: OutputSpec

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, entity
type.title: Type

where.description: Which entities qualify ($it, $actor, $params for earlier params, $pending).
where.title: Where

values.description: Allowed values or an expression giving them (type enum).
values.title: Values

required.description: Defaults to true unless a default is given.
required.title: Required

invalid.description: What the agent is told when its value is not valid (template over $actor, $params, $value).
invalid.title: Invalid

PhysicsSpec.description: Continuous dynamics advanced every round before agents act. Deterministic.

read.description: Names refreshed from the world before each step: {N: '$count(person)'}.
read.title: Read

PhysicsSpec.title: PhysicsSpec

PhysicsVar.description: A continuous variable. With ``rate`` it is integrated (RK4): d(var)/dt = rate.
PhysicsVar.title: PhysicsVar

PlaneSpace.description: A width × height area; positions are [x, y]. Distance is straight-line.
PlaneSpace.title: PlaneSpace

PolicyRule.description:
One rule of a coded policy: when `when` holds (and the `chance` roll passes), call `do` with `with`.
With `each`, the rule is tried once per item ($it): "for each of my armies, hold".

each.description: A type or expression; the rule is tried for every item ($it).
each.title: Each

PolicyRule.title: PolicyRule

PolicySpec.description: A coded participant: the first rule whose condition holds and whose action is legal is taken.

repeat.description: Keep applying rules until the turn ends (default: one action).
repeat.title: Repeat

PolicySpec.title: PolicySpec

PopulationSpec.description: Entities generated at load: a count, one per table row, or a weighted sample of rows.

count.description: How many (number or expression). Omit with `from` = one per row.
count.title: Count

weight.description: Row sampling weight ($row); sampled without replacement.
weight.title: Weight

brief.description: Private text added to each generated entity's brief (template over $row, $i).
brief.title: Brief

PopulationSpec.title: PopulationSpec

PropSpec.description:
One property. Shorthand: a bare value is the default (``"cash": 100``).

In a type that ``extends`` another, a property the parent declares is overridden field by
field: only the fields written here change (a bare value changes only the default), so the
parent's ``private``, ``type``, ``min``, ``max`` and ``values`` still apply.

type.description: One of: number, int, bool, text, enum, list, map, any (inferred from default).
type.title: Type

default.description: Literal or expression (evaluated when the entity is created).
default.title: Default

private.description: Hidden from other agents' inspect tool.
private.title: Private

PropSpec.title: PropSpec

RecordSpec.description: An append-only log (chat, reviews, bids, transcript). New entries reach agents as news.

fields.description: {field: type}; text fields written by agents are marked untrusted.
fields.title: Fields

visible.description: 'all' or an expression over $viewer and $it (the entry).
visible.title: Visible

keep.description: Keep only the latest N entries.
keep.title: Keep

notify.description: Deliver new entries to agents in 'since your last turn'.
notify.title: Notify

RecordSpec.title: RecordSpec

RelationSpec.description: A kind of link between entities (follows, trusts, owns …).
RelationSpec.title: RelationSpec

Space.description: Where entities are (``at``). Declare exactly one of grid, graph, plane.
Space.title: Space

StageSpec.description: One step of every round. Stages run in order; each wakes agents to take turns.

when.description: Run this stage only when true (e.g. $round == 1).
when.title: When

turns.description: sequential (one after another, effects immediate) | simultaneous (same picture, committed together).
turns.title: Turns

until.description: Repeat turns within the round until true.
until.title: Until

passes.description: Max passes through the agents (default 1, or 10 with until).
passes.title: Passes

quiet.description: wake | skip — skip agents with nothing new since their last turn.
quiet.title: Quiet

max_actions.description: Actions an agent may take per turn.
max_actions.title: Max Actions

must_act.description: While an action is available, the agent cannot just end its turn.
must_act.title: Must Act

on_idle.description: Effects for each agent that ends its turn without acting ($actor): a forfeit, a default move.
on_idle.title: On Idle

StageSpec.title: StageSpec

TypeSpec.description:
A kind of entity. ``agent: true`` types take turns. ``extends`` inherits another type:
its props, its agent flag, and membership (``$count(trader)`` counts every kind of trader).

extends.description: Parent type whose props and role this type inherits.
extends.title: Extends

policy.description: Default coded policy for agents of this type.
policy.title: Policy

inspect.description: Whether agents may inspect these entities: true, false, or an expression over $viewer and $it.
inspect.title: Inspect

TypeSpec.title: TypeSpec

ViewSpec.description: A declared, ranked slice of the world rendered as plain lines for agents.

of.description: Entity type or expression giving items; omit for a single line.
of.title: Of

show.description: Template for one item (or the single line).
show.title: Show

empty.description: Text when no items match (omit to hide the view).
empty.title: Empty

look.description: Offer it on demand as look(view) instead of always including it.
look.title: Look

bullet.description: Prefix each item with '- ' (false for boards and tables).
bullet.title: Bullet

only_changes.description: Include it only when it changed since the agent's last turn.
only_changes.title: Only Changes

ViewSpec.title: ViewSpec

description: An environment: world, people, rules, what agents see, what is measured.

blocks.description: Reusable effect lists, run with {"block": name}.
blocks.title: Blocks

mechanisms.description: Native building blocks by name: {name: {"kind": ..., ...config}}; see the guide's mechanisms part.
mechanisms.title: Mechanisms

title: Contract
